subject: Culture
title: The Left Hand Taboo
description: A fast breakdown of The Left Hand Taboo for builders.

hook.text: In South Asia and the Middle East, handing someone food with your left hand is an insult.

buildup.text: The left hand was historically reserved for personal hygiene. It became permanently 'unclean.'

discovery.text: The word 'sinister' comes from Latin for left. Europeans once forced left-handed kids to switch.

twist.text: In Japan, left-handedness has no stigma. But in Ghana, even left-handed pointing is rude.

climax.text: Modern plumbing made the original reason extinct. The taboo survived anyway.

punchline.text: Some customs outlive their logic by centuries.

quiz.question: What Latin-derived word meaning 'left' also means threatening?
